env.tokenizer: tiktoken cl100k_base (n_vocab=100277); NOT bundled in repo, matched by vocab size

pca_caveat: N_samples < real_dim_full => rank <= N-1; samples within a sequence are highly autocorrelated.
id_caveat: k-NN ID estimators are biased low for N << exp(d) and by non-uniform density; treat as upper-/lower-bound-ish indicators.
